description: by Team FiorettiCharleston, Illinois, will host Bob Fioretti's fourth event in a seven-debate series modeled on one of the state’s best-known political traditions when candidates and community members gather. Join us on Friday, Oct. 16, from 1:30 to 3:30 p.m. at the Lincoln-Douglas Debate Museum Auditorium.The event is part of Bob Fioretti's planned series scheduled during the same historic time frame as the Lincoln-Douglas debates of 1858.
